name: update_proposal_votes_unsorted_input
note: proposal_ids is flat_set_ex<int64_t> on chain: fc::raw::pack casts it to flat_set (iteration order = ascending), from_variant asserts "Items should be unique and sorted", and legacy 0.7 sorted numeric arrays too (Types.array -> sortOperation, numeric compare). The input here is deliberately unordered ([42, 1]), so this fixture pins the canonicalisation: expected_hex is byte-identical to update_proposal_votes_basic's, which is the legacy golden for the same id set.
